question: How did my last pay cycle go?
title: Your last pay cycle

cells.title: The last full pay cycle, as on the home screen
cells.code:
PENSION = (me.get("age") or 0) >= 68
PAY = "pension day" if PENSION else "payday"
PAY_TO = "pension day" if PENSION else "payday"
CYCLE = "pension cycle" if PENSION else "pay cycle"
def day(s):
    d = datetime.date.fromisoformat(str(s)[:10])
    return f"{d.day} {d:%b}"
emit("pay_word", PAY, "text", "The day money comes in")
emit("pay_to", PAY_TO, "text", "The day money comes in")

lc = kori.last_cycle()
cy = lc.get("cycle") or {}
parts = [{"label": "Bills", "amount": cy.get("fixed", 0)}, {"label": "A share for surprises", "amount": cy.get("surprise_reserve", 0)}]
if (cy.get("planned_saving") or 0) > 0:
    parts.append({"label": "Planned saving", "amount": cy["planned_saving"]})
hist = [{"label": h["label"], "last_day": h["last_day"], "everyday_spent": h["everyday_spent"], "everyday_available": h["everyday_available"],
         "within": h["within"]} for h in (lc.get("history") or {}).get("cycles") or []]
ok = lc.get("available") and not lc.get("partial_view") and cy and hist and lc.get("history_line") and \
    abs(cy["income"] - sum(p["amount"] for p in parts) - cy["everyday_available"]) < 0.005
if ok:                                            # only part of the money on this account: no kept answer, worked out fresh
    emit("period", cy["label"], "text", "The last full cycle")
    emit("income", cy["income"], "eur", "Money that came in")
    emit("everyday_available", cy["everyday_available"], "eur", "Room left for everyday")
    emit("everyday_spent", cy["everyday_spent"], "eur", "Spent on everyday")
    emit("difference", cy["difference"], "eur", "Over by" if not cy["within"] else "Left unspent")
    emit("history_line", lc["history_line"], "text", "How often it fit")
    table("parts", parts, "Taken off first")
    table("history", hist, "The last cycles")
    text = f"Your last {CYCLE}, {cy['label']}, went **{eur(cy['difference'], True)}** over: {eur(cy['everyday_spent'])} went to everyday, with room for {eur(cy['everyday_available'])}." if not cy["within"] else f"Your last {CYCLE}, {cy['label']}, fit with **{eur(cy['difference'], True)}** to spare: {eur(cy['everyday_spent'])} went to everyday, with room for {eur(cy['everyday_available'])}."
    if lc.get("driver_line"):
        emit("what_did_it", lc["driver_line"], "text", "What did it")
        text += " " + lc["driver_line"]
    say(text)
